thread:
maria: CI is red for a bunch of PRs — failure spikes in the integration job. Looks like mock-user-db is returning 503s in the ci-ephemeral cluster.

sasha: same, failing in user_service_test::should_create_user. error:
```
HTTP 503 from http://mock-user-db.internal: read timeout
stack: ...
```

jon: on it, bisecting the x-builds. @devops-jen can you check the mock-user-db pods? :eyes:

devops-jen: seeing CrashLoopBackOff on mock-user-db-0, kube shows OOMKilled twice. restarting the statefulset now:
```
kubectl -n ci rollout restart sts/mock-user-db
kubectl -n ci describe pod mock-user-db-0
```

infra-bot: deploy-bot: restarted statefulset mock-user-db in ci (uid=st-9a3f)

qa-lee: re-running the failing pipeline jobs (queued) — will report back when they finish.

jon: quick bisect shows a change in the mock snapshot loader in #1234 that could be the culprit, but need infra logs to confirm.

devops-jen: looking at pod logs, snapshot restore is failing with checksum error:
```
2026-03-17T14:02:05Z ERROR restore failed: open /var/lib/mockdb/snap-20260317.tar: checksum mismatch
2026-03-17T14:02:05Z WARN falling back to empty DB
```
I'll spin up a fresh pod from a clean snapshot and keep the old one for forensics.

maria: if it's going to take >30m can we temporarily skip the flaky user create test in CI? tag with flaky-skip and unblock PRs.

sasha: agree, please add a short notice in the PR comments. also can someone file INFRA ticket for snapshot corruption?

devops-jen: created INFRA-456: 'mock-user-db snapshot CRC mismatch on ci'. assigning to infra-oncall. rolling out new pod from snapshot clean-20260310.

qa-lee: jobs rerun: 3/4 passed, the last one is still hitting 503s intermittently — looks like partial restoration.

jon: thanks. I'll hold off merging my PRs until we get confirmation.

maria: thanks everyone — adding notes to #incidents and marking the affected PRs as blocked/unblocked as appropriate. :thumbsup:

devops-jen: INFRA-456 updated with logs + retained broken pod. ping @sasha for verification.
